definitions.explanation: An organ in and around the mouth that produces and secretes saliva. Humans have several, including those in the cheeks and under the tongue.

examples.japanese: {唾液|だえき}{腺|せん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{唾液|だえき}→唾液：15943_daeki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Saliva comes out of the salivary glands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅干|うめぼ}し→梅干し：13110_umeboshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{唾液|だえき}{腺|せん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{刺激|しげき}される→刺激する：20205_shigekisuru⟧。
examples.english: Seeing a pickled plum stimulates the salivary glands.

examples.japanese: {唾液|だえき}{腺|せん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{炎症|えんしょう}→炎症：05978_enshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: When the salivary glands become inflamed, you feel pain while eating.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{唾液|だえき}→唾液：15943_daeki⟧ (saliva) + ⟦{腺|せん}→腺：17997_sen⟧ (gland). An anatomy term for the glands that secrete saliva into the mouth.
